description: This Java class represents an immutable JSON pointer, providing methods for parsing, constructing, and manipulating JSON pointer paths consisting of JsonKey elements. It includes functionality for encoding/decoding tilde characters, appending levels, and extracting sub-pointers.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPointer
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the JsonPointer interface, representing a hierarchical path of JSON keys with methods for parsing, extending, and retrieving sub-paths.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty JSON pointer.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a character sequence into a JsonPointer, handling special cases and splitting by slashes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer from a root JsonKey and optional sub-keys.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new JsonPointer from a root JsonKey and a sub-JsonPointer.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new JsonPointer with an additional JsonKey appended.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a sub-JsonPointer to the current pointer, returning a new combined pointer.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels (keys) in the pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the pointer has no levels.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JsonKey at a specified level, if present.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root JsonKey, if present.

methods.name: getLeaf
methods.description: Returns the last JsonKey in the pointer, if present.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Returns a sub-pointer starting from a specified level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Returns a prefix sub-pointer up to a specified level.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Returns a new pointer without the last key.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Returns the sub-pointer starting from the second level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts the pointer to a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the JsonKeys.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the list of JsonKeys.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the list of JsonKeys.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation of the pointer.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string form of the JSON pointer, with levels separated by slashes.
